content: {"like":["Enjoys high‑quality action‑thrillers with strong cat‑and‑mouse dynamics (e.g., The Jackal).","Prefers disaster or survival films with impressive special effects and realistic destruction (e.g., Asteroid).","Values faithful adaptations of classic literature with excellent visual and audio presentation (e.g., Raise The Titanic).","Appreciates dramatic period dramas that showcase strong performances (e.g., Titanic).","Enjoys well‑executed time‑travel narratives that keep viewers guessing (e.g., Running Against Time)."],"dislike":["Dislikes sequels that fail to match the original’s quality or cast (e.g., Speed 2).","Avoids films that condense extended content into a shorter, less satisfying format (e.g., Asteroid).","Rejects adaptations that omit key plot confrontations or details from the source (e.g., Raise The Titanic).","Criticizes historical dramas with noticeable inaccuracies in set design (e.g., Titanic).","Dislikes action installments that fall below earlier standards in a series (e.g., Lethal Weapon 4)."]}
